Kamrup (Metro) Assam 7:The Director Of Health Services Assam Hengrabari Guwahati-36. 8:The Drugs Controller Assam Hengrabari Guwahati-3 Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. K N Choudhury, Mr. D J Das,Md I H Laskar,Mr. M Ahmed Advocate for the Respondent : Sc, Health, Sc, Apsc,Sc, Finance Page No.# 3/4 Before Honourable Mr. Justice Soumitra Saikia Order
texts.facts: The petition is filed by the two petitioners who are presently serving as Inspector of Drugs under the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Assam and their services were not regularised because of which they have approached this Court on two earlier occasions being W.P(C) No. 2135 of 2025 and W.P(C) No. 2137 of 2025, which were preferred by the petitioners, assailing the orders by the department for not regularising their services , the writ petitions came to be dismissed.
texts.arguments: The learned Senior counsel for the petitioners submits that against the Judgment and Order dated 27-08-2025, passed in WPC 2135 of 2025 and the other with petition, an intra-Court appeal has been preferred, which is presently pending.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The learned Senior counsel for the petitioners submits that against the Judgment and Order dated 27-08-2025, passed in WPC 2135 of 2025 and the other with petition, an intra-Court appeal has been preferred, which is presently pending.
